subject: general
question:
Select the word that is closest in meaning (SYNONYM) to the word given below.

Wallow
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e. **'Flounder'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Wallow" **means to roll about or lie relaxed in mud or water, especially to keep cool, avoid biting insects, or spread scent.
 
• In a more figurative sense, it can also mean to indulge in an unrestrained way in something that creates a pleasurable sensation or to be or remain helpless and not try to improve a difficult or unsatisfactory situation.(अनुरक्त होना)
 
• **Flounder: **This means to struggle or stagger clumsily in mud or water, to struggle mentally, show or feel great confusion, or to be in serious difficulty.(परेशान होना)
 
• This** word **is **closest **in meaning to **"wallow".**

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Flounder'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
